reason: Our agent volume is tiny today, and a proxy that checks caps, routes big orders to a human and has a kill switch is something my team can build in a quarter on top of controls we already run. I'll answer the examiner's AI question with our own policy and logs, not a vendor with no customers sitting in the trade path.
objection: You'd be putting an unaudited startup with zero customers in front of every agent order, and the evidence export only helps if an examiner trusts the vendor producing it. No SOC 2 yet, and a design-partner LOI that commits us to a price before I know whether agent traffic ever matters.
would_change_my_mind: Agent-originated orders becoming a real share of our flow while an examiner or FINRA explicitly expects know-your-agent controls we can't stand up in a quarter, with a completed SOC 2 and a peer broker already running it in production.
